meta.title: Danbooru tools
meta.description: Read-only Danbooru tools: post and tag search (year, rating, Hot/score order), tag details with wiki excerpts, related tags; artist discovery by a whole year's total favorites (default 5% body-shape tag gate), a Hot / favorite-growth / fallback weighted sampler, and similar artists (tag profile + facial-expression profile re-ranked by expression-tag cosine, with furry themes downweighted). Examples prefer posts that carry the requested tags and show the face; allow_no_face=true permits back views, silhouettes and other face-hidden compositions. Saved credentials lift the tag limit. R18 is included by default; pass rating=g for general only.
